data.title: 2H 2025 Transparency Report Statistics
data.content:
Kakao has not provided communication user information since the first half of 2013.
 
In response to requests for communication-restricting measures related to Daum services, limited data is provided following strict review in accordance with applicable laws. We do not provide any data on communication-restricting measures that pertain to Kakao services.
 
The number of communication confirmation data requests and processed requests related to Daum services decreased by 26.7% and 43.3%, respectively, compared to the first half of 2025, while those for Kakao services increased by 6% and 2%, respectively, over the same period.
 
Requests for search and seizure warrants related to Daum services decreased by 19.7% compared to the first half of 2025, while those for Kakao services decreased by 7.2% over the same period.
 
Kakao strives to provide only the minimum information necessary in accordance with legal requirements.
